dishes.name: Kig ha farz
dishes.desc: Breton pot-au-feu from the Léon in northern Finistère: pork and beef simmered with vegetables and a buckwheat farz cooked in a cloth bag, served with a shallot-and-butter sauce.

dishes.name: Kouign-amann
dishes.desc: A caramelised cake of laminated dough, butter and sugar, born in Douarnenez in Finistère. Dark and crisp outside, soft and very buttery inside.

dishes.name: Cotriade
dishes.desc: Finistère's fisherman's stew of mixed fish, potatoes and onions in a butter-enriched broth, eaten over bread. A staple of the ports around Douarnenez and Concarneau.

dishes.name: Pâté Hénaff
dishes.desc: Pork pâté from Pouldreuzic in the Bigouden country, created in 1915 and now a Finistère emblem in its blue tin. Sold in every local shop and eaten on bread.

dishes.name: Palets bretons
dishes.desc: Thick, crumbly butter biscuits with salted butter, a speciality of Pont-Aven in southern Finistère. Sold in tins by local bakeries and biscuit makers.
